title: Code and data: light-transport models and machine-learning surrogate for plasmonic photothermal planning
description: Python code (Gans optics, Beer-Lambert, delta-P1 and Monte Carlo light transport, Pennes bioheat, CEM43 dose, ANN, XGBoost and smooth-function surrogates, exact design refinement, robust and heterogeneity-aware design) and data (digitised temperatures, 846,126-sample design dataset) for the article 'Monte Carlo, not Beer–Lambert: blind-validated light models and machine learning for safe NIR-II photothermal planning'.
